page_title: LEC 0-1 NAP | Lecce v Napoli 28/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' Konan Ndri (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul.
90+5' Napoli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+4' Konan Ndri (Lecce) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+2' The ball is cleared after Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+1' An attempted cross from Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) is cleared.
90+1' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) brings his opponent down. Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
88' Konan Ndri (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giuseppe Collu had an easy-decision to make.
86' The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.
85' Substitution. Eljif Elmas did his best and is replaced by Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli).
84' Poor challenge! Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is penalised for tripping and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle.
83' A pass by Scott McTominay (Napoli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
82' Napoli are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
81' Youssef Maleh (Lecce) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
80' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
78' The Lecce players are exchanging some short passes.
78' A clumsy foul by Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle.
77' Substitution. Youssef Maleh has come on for Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce).
77' That's the end of the game for Medon Berisha (Lecce), who is replaced by Balthazar Pierret.
75' Scott McTominay (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
72' Lecce quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
72' Medon Berisha (Lecce) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nikola Stulic (Lecce) comes onto the pitch so that Francesco Camarda can be given a rest.
69' 0 - 1 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Frank Anguissa (Napoli) who rises and scores with a thunderous header inside the left post. An incredible long-range header!
68' Napoli fail to score from a corner as Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce) leaps to collect the ball.
66' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
66' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Konan Ndri (Lecce) coming on for Lameck Banda.
64' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) was quite harsh and Giuseppe Collu didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
61' Here comes a substitution. Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Mathias Olivera.
61' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Matteo Politano and he is replaced by Scott McTominay (Napoli).
61' That will be all from Lorenzo Lucca who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli).
59' Tete Morente (Lecce) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
57' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

56' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
56' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
54' It’s a PENALTY to Lecce after the VAR review!

52' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Lecce.
52' Juan Jesus (Napoli) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.

51' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom left corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
49' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
49' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
48' David Neres (Napoli) comes onto the pitch after Noa Lang signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
47' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' It is time for a substitution. Tete Morente (Lecce) is on for Santiago Pierotti.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' A long pass, executed by Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
44' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 34:66.
41' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
40' Lameck Banda (Lecce) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
39' A cross from Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
38' Napoli hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

36' Wladimiro Falcone makes a brilliant save! Noa Lang (Napoli) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
33' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle as Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
30' Matteo Politano (Napoli) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just inches over the bar.
29' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
28' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 3:3.
26' Giuseppe Collu shows a yellow card to Mathias Olivera (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
25' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
19' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
19' Lecce hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
18' Matteo Politano (Napoli) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
17' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
15' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.
10' Some neat passing and movement from Lecce as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
9' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
9' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
7' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
5' Great teamplay by Napoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
4' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Giuseppe Collu no option but to blow his whistle.
3' Noa Lang (Napoli) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Napoli will take the kick-off.
Giuseppe Collu is the one to supervise the game today.
